parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler, typically made of steel, forms the main structural component that holds the internal mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the housing for the stapling mechanism and connects the lid and base, ensuring alignment during stapling.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but supports the pivoting motion of the lid.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the stapler, made of durable plastic, covers the top and is the part pressed by the user.
parts.Functional_description: It transmits the user's force to the internal mechanism to drive staples through paper.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots downward around a hinge when pressed and returns upward when released.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the stapler, made of plastic, provides a stable platform for stapling operations.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the paper and contains the anvil that bends the staple legs inward or outward.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, providing resistance to the downward force from the lid.
